editorial_rules.stats_tuning: Stats support the vision without overwhelming
editorial_rules.body_copy_tuning: Body copy stays warm and specific (friendly is not casual)

most_likely_failure.failure: Warmth sliding into looseness, or inclusivity sliding into vagueness
most_likely_failure.correction: Friendly is not casual. Keep the invitation specific: who, what, when, why come.

notes: The community catalyst. Warmth of a host, insight of an industry pioneer. Generous with knowledge, open to questions, aimed at sparking the next idea. Friendly and human without being sloppy; welcoming to students and experts in the same sentence. Knowledge is shared, never gatekept.
